title: Churches in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Berliner Dom, EUR 15 (reduced EUR 12):** Monday to Saturday 9:00 to 18:00, Sunday 12:00 to 18:00, last entry 17:00. The ticket covers the crypt, the museum and the dome walkway at 50 metres. Allow about 1.5 hours.
**St. Marienkirche by the TV Tower is free** and open daily 10:00 to 18:00, with the 22-metre medieval Dance of Death mural in the tower hall.
**St. Hedwig's Cathedral on Bebelplatz is free:** reopened in November 2024, open 11:00 to 18:00 most days, Friday to 20:00, Sunday from 13:00.
**Friedrichswerdersche Kirche is free and closed on Mondays.** The Parochialkirche opens only on weekdays from 9:00 to 14:00.
**Nikolaikirche is a museum, EUR 7:** Thursday is the late day, 12:00 to 20:00.
**Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church:** the new church is open daily 10:00 to 18:00, free, but the memorial hall exhibition in the old tower is closed for renovation since 29 August 2026.
**My move:** start at St. Marienkirche at 10:00, see the Parochialkirche before 14:00, and go to the Dom at 9:00 or after 16:00. On Sunday, save the Dom for the afternoon.
